prompt: Create src/index.ts exporting `packShelves(items: number[], capacity: number): number[][]`. Items are positive integers. Fill shelves in input order using this exact rule: place each item on the LAST shelf if it fits (running sum plus item <= capacity); otherwise open a new shelf. If a single item exceeds capacity it gets a shelf of its own. Return the shelves as arrays of the items in placement order. An empty items array returns an empty array. Throw a RangeError if capacity is not a positive integer.
